theorems.name: Submission.allard_tc_unique_tangent_plane
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U) (x : Euclidean N) (θ₀ : ℝ) (ν : Measure (Grassmannian N n)), x ∈ U → 0 < θ₀ → (∀ t : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ j, 0 < t j) → Tendsto t atTop (𝓝 0) → ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ ∃ C : Varifold N n (univ : Set (Euclidean N)), VagueConverges (fun j ↦ rescaledMeasure V x (t (φ j))) C.measure) → (∀ C : Varifold N n (univ : Set (Euclidean N)), IsVarifoldTangent V x C → ∃ T : Grassmannian N n, C.measure = ENNReal.ofReal θ₀ • planeVarifoldMeasure T) → (∀ β : C(Grassmannian N n, ℝ), Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ ↦ (∫ z in closedBall x ρ ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n)), β z.2 ∂V.measure) / (V.weight (closedBall x ρ)).toReal) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (∫ S, β S ∂ν))) → ∃ T : Grassmannian N n, HasTangentPlane V x T θ₀
